This '''Corellian settlement''' was a [[City/Legends|town]] located on a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was inhabited by settlers of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] descent, including [[Jenna (Corellian)|Jenna]], [[Jenna's father|her father]] and [[Ovin]]. A [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]] served as the local lawman. The settlement had a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and a [[Prison/Legends|jailhouse]] which was mainly used as a [[Medical bay/Legends|med-bay]].
